folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B157, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full assessment and [execution checkpoint](../gm/dispatch/inventory-overhaul-2026-10-21/CHECKPOINT.md) were reviewed. Its later captured release implements I2-I5 through actual native/UI consumers and records combined browser, persistence, Electron and publication proof. Keep the table as the original design/gap evidence, not a fresh four-item missing-feature queue. This reconciliation did not inspect today's app, remote branch or exact current source (AD32, AD36).

Preserve I1's fixture limits: thirty-one stacks, largely quality variants of one kind, pressure-test exact selection and large-text density without proving every mixed/damaged inventory. Structured fit, condition, custody and final character effects are distinct from an item-only score. Catalogue compatibility does not grant possession/access, and multi-holder transfers need the actual owner/transaction. Existing compact proportions, expanded inspection and full Reports remain meaningful choices; an overhaul does not consume every panel or invent a second stock store. No new transfer or runtime behavior was tested here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B157, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Read CRL31 and the full preview handoff. The opening combined-baseline qualification supersedes the bottom unrun-root-browser language for its captured inputs. Preserve the actual defect and repair: validate optional source rows inside their entry boundary, so one malformed label does not abort healthy Find/navigation. This presentation containment does not replace native command, save or transaction failure handling.

The existing customization preview is a real component-style consumer with draft/active isolation; it is not another editor or proof that Apply saved every theme. Native adjacent controls should retain the active profile until commitment. Historical browser closure stays with the baseline receipt, not a new current Find/Ctrl+K or contrast test. No optional widget, loader or theme code was changed (AD32, AD36, AD42).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B157, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full observation and compatibility receipt read. The existing opening note records the later root browser/persistence closure and gear lineage slice; the original bottom handoff is historical. Keep specimen birth/true elapsed condition distinct from an observer's dated skill-qualified estimate. New inspections append without rewriting prior uncertainty; old absent observation history does not invent earlier readings. Free observation is this actual route, not a new skill grant.

Selected lot/start/cancel identity, later processed-material chest split/return and general product aging are separate capabilities. A later lineage adapter does not prove all finished inventory stacks retain individual age, or every item spoils. The 60/30/10-minute bands are local authored estimates; no universal clock, perception penalty or upkeep follows. No specimen source, estimate, unit/native test or current save was newly exercised here (AD32, AD36, AR6).
